dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Ah, you're here. Thanks for helping us clear the path. Zhiqiong was also a big help in guiding us, as well, so thank you both.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Well, it looks good, eh? My specialty, by the way.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: I started learning all this from my father starting from the time I was around ten... How to set up campsites, how to make crystal lamps, how to maintain mining equipment...

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: I learned and learned, and my father grew old all the while... Eventually, when his eyesight started failing, it fell to me to maintain the safety equipment in the mine.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: And even later on... Well, as you can see, I'm not young anymore myself. As for the rest of my tale, it's not much... I found a man, lost a man, had a daughter who went off to Sumeru to study...

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Sometimes, when the men at the mines leave us early, it falls to me to take care of their kids... So I carry some sweets around all the time.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: And that's why... in my mind, kids always look this way to me: sweet-smelling, staring at me from where they are on the ground, waiting for candy or some colorful rocks to play with.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa. Uh, so, do you have candy on you right now, Jinwu?

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Candy? Well, it's not the fancy type like you'd get in the city, but you're not going to be picky now, are you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, so that's the kind of candy you're talking about...

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: People come and go, leaving only memories behind to accompany me... and adventurers who go into the mines like you, of course.

choices.text: Tell me a bit about Zhiqiong.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Zhiqiong's from our latest batch of miners, and she was born in Mingyun Village. To be honest, all the experienced miners at The Chasm were from Mingyun Village. Zhiqiong was just born at the wrong time.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Ah, don't get me wrong, I'm not saying that times are hard. I'm just saying that the ore veins dried up at Mingyun a good long time ago, so work there has already ceased.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Shortly after Zhiqiong came to The Chasm, the incident happened and work here stopped as well. I guess she and mining just aren't meant to be.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Uh...

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Everyone went their separate ways after that. I stayed, though — it's not as if the equipment will maintain themselves. She, on the other hand, became an adventurer.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: She hasn't grown up at all, though, and still doesn't value her life at all... or maybe she's just spent too little time down in the mines.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: I'm pretty sure that getting used to the mining life and saving a few people from perilous situations might give her a new appreciation for life.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Well, I'm not sure if I can make this request of you, but could you watch over her for me? I'd hate to see her get herself killed.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Alright then. Take care!

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Hello! How have your travels been going?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Fine, and you?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Thanks for giving me that opportunity back there. After our attempt to create the cannonball fuse earlier succeeded, everyone's warmed up to the idea of letting me stay.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: As for what I'll do after getting back to the surface... Heh, I haven't thought it all through yet, but I probably won't rejoin the Treasure Hoarders!

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Uh, oh, I mean, I'm definitely never rejoining the Treasure Hoarders! Definitely!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: See you.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Take care of yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: That... *sigh* Eh? Oh. Hello. Sorry. You bothered me there.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, does that make us even?

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Alright, no need to horse around. Our current situation is not good. Not good at all, really.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: You've seen that shining crystal fragment already, right? If my guess is not off, there should be an even larger one deeper down... Although I suppose you already knew that.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: In theory, our readings should have stabilized once the fragment above "returned" to its original location. And that's what happened, in fact... But the waveform is wrong... all wrong.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Not much of a student, were you? Well then, let me put this simply. We are currently akin to beans on a stone mill, on the brink of a clash between two great powers.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Albeit on a larger time scale, we are presently being crushed by these two forces — one from above and one from below — and we shall soon be turned into bean paste!

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Just wait and see if you don't believe me yet. That adventurer named Zhiqiong... Well, I've seen what happens to those who get too close to such things.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Today it's going to be coughing up blood, and tomorrow, she might just cough her innards out too.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is there anything I can do to help?

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: You? Well, give me some time to think... There's got to some way we can...

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Well, whatever the case, what we need most urgently now is for you to continue exploring until you find out what happened down there.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Don't worry, I won't sit by and do nothing in this situation. I've got to make sure that my investments see return, after all, so I must see to the safety of the exploration team.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Will you be taking responsibility for me, too?

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Mmm, well... I have to admit that your abilities have completely exceeded my estimations. As such, I think that you're more than capable of taking responsibility for yourself.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Agh, never mind, what am I saying... If something does happen to you, I'll compensate you, okay?

choices.text: Use words that I understand, please.

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: Sorry, I'm a little dizzy at the moment, but I can take it! Ugh...

choices.text: What is it you're doing here?

response.speaker: Taliesin
response.text: I consider myself a bard of the old school, so of course I'm here to get some inspiration.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well! You looked pretty alright just a moment ago, and now you look like you're about to drop any second!

response.speaker: Taliesin
response.text: I've never gone down into a mine before... And in my hurry during in getting here, I wound up... pulling a muscle.

response.speaker: Taliesin
response.text: Ow ow ow...

response.speaker: Taliesin
response.text: Agh... This medicinal oil really isn't doing it for me... Well, see you, and do come to me again when you have new stories to tell, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Oh, you're here.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Something's been wrong with Zhiqiong lately. I suspect that it's that... tainted stuff that's affecting her mind and body.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Whatever it is, it's strikingly similar to the way in which locals here five hundred years ago described the dark calamity...

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: But today, the Yakshas are a distant memory, and Rex Lapis too has left us... I must admit that this is the most worried I've ever been for the safety of us mortals.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Sorry... I kept you back just to tell you all this pointless nonsense. Still...

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Never mind... You stay safe now, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Zhiqiong left just a moment ago. She seemed pretty angry about something... Do you know what happened?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: I mean, come on! She said that she wouldn't be mad at me anymore... and yet her temper hasn't changed for the better in the slightest since coming to this campsite.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: That Khedive guy's telling everyone that Zhiqiong's lost it and has to leave The Chasm...

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Heh. Sounds like he's the one who needs to get his head checked.

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: Phew, the swelling in my leg's gone down... as has the pain. I should probably write an epic for Liyue's medicinal oils, hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: Ah, sorry, didn't see you there — I've just been resting over here all this while.

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: If you're looking for Zhiqiong, I believe she said that she was looking for some kind of gate...

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: She said that she'd share the story of her adventure with me, too. Just head over that way, you should find her easily.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Sorry for telling you all that.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: I won't take up any more of your time... We've all got things to busy ourselves with, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Back again, are we? Do you need something?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Zhiqiong...

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: She went back up to fix some map errata. I'm not sure what the hurry's about... But it's good to see that she's in good spirits.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Whatever you, whatever the case... I don't know what methods you used to bring her back, but I'm just glad she is. We all are, really.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Hello there! If you're up for a chat, I'm all ears!

choices.text: Well, you sure look like a pair of idle hands.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Oh, come on. Are you taking me for a slacker? I'll have you know that every time I'm needed, I barely have time for anything else!

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Her? She seems to have calmed down a lot after coming back. Honestly, I wonder if it isn't just this eerie environment that's making everyone's fuses shorter and tempers hotter.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: I was just scolded by Jinwu not long ago. Never seen her that angry in my life... Still gives me chills to think about it.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: See you, and take care!

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help. Without your aid so far, I'm quite sure our expedition would have proved a failure.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: I don't know what you did, but the readings of the Ley Line flows in this area have stabilized significantly... Heh, and the expansion of the contaminants is currently slowing.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: As for why that is... Perhaps the answer may be found even deeper in the earth, but really, who knows?

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: And as for Zhiqiong... Well, all I'll say is that she can still leave now. She values The Chasm over her life... not realizing that The Chasm seems set on taking it from her.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: I'm very sorry... I know my stubbornness caused you a lot of trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: I'll continue to refine the maps I've made and help Jinwu place beacons to observe the behavior of that dark substance.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: They... They say that this substance might be related to the dark calamity that occurred five hundred years ago. It's just unclear if it's an aftershock, or if it's just a sign of things still to come...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, thanks for showing me the limitations of a normal human being, and... for showing me how to pursue my dreams within those limits.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. Look who's sounding like a philosopher now, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I never thought quite that deeply, I think.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: It's just that... you've helped me so much, and by comparison, I need your help just to do simple things like drawing maps...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: And I always drag you down when we get into dangerous situations...

choices.text: I'm just concerned for your safety.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Yes... And I won't give up, either. I'll set out again once I've rested enough.

choices.text: It's fine. I hope that you can finish your maps.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Haha, you're back. Well then, sit down and rest for a bit. Make yourself at home!

choices.text: I wouldn't call this place "homely," per se.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Hahahaha! Ow, your tongue's sharp!

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Thanks to your help, the atmosphere at the camp has become way more relaxed. If I gave you the impression that I was the overly-serious sort before, I'm very sorry about that.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: The important business has already been settled. Now, the long-term work that remains is... setting up a permanent lookout underground to watch for any changes in the situation.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: During this period, many mines can now be partially opened, but going this far underground is still forbidden.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: We need to seal up this area and prevent any miners... No, prevent anyone from coming down here.

choices.text: What am I now, a tunnel-dweller?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Ah, you're here! Welcome to the Chasm Exploration Team's demolitions team base and water point!

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: We — by which I mean I, Clitopho — salute you!

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Come, come, have a drink! Consider it my treat — just a little something for all you've done for me.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Well, I'm an official member of the team now, so since they're staying, I'm staying.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Well, things would certainly be easier if Khedive and Jinwu could get me some extra help...

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Though that said, I wouldn't be able to call myself the sole member *and* team leader if that were to happen.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: #Oh? Why, hello there! I thought you'd left, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: The energy readings around here have stabilized a great deal, thanks to you. When I go back and write my thesis, I will mention you for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: However, as the nominal employer of the exploration team, I will still need to stay for a long time to observe this place.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, I've got to go.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Then I shan't keep you. Just know that you'll always be welcome with the exploration team!
